title: Heavy courses
statementMd:
List courses worth 4 credits.

Expected columns: `title`, `department`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, department FROM courses WHERE credits = 4;
```
